summary: Allocate an audio subsystem block, initialize it, load game filter data into it, then wrap the block in a 12-byte list node appended to this object's linked list. Optionally removes an existing node first when DelegatedFieldGetter(this) returns 2. On an empty list the new node becomes head, tail and secondary pointer; otherwise it is appended to the tail. The node count this+0xC is incremented on insertion and the function always returns 0.

operations.description: If DelegatedFieldGetter(this) returns 2, LinkedListNodeRemovalWithCleanup(this) removes an existing node from the list before inserting the new one
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(45396) allocates the audio subsystem block; when non-null, AudioSubsystemInitializer(v2) initializes it into v3 (else v3 = 0)
GameFilterDataLoader(v3) loads the game filter data into the initialized audio block
If v3 is non-zero, OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates the list node; it is initialized as v4+0 = v3 (payload pointer), v4+4 = 0 (next), v4+8 = 1 (flag)
If the list is empty (this+0x0 == 0): set head this+0x0, secondary this+0x8 and tail this+0x4 all to the new node, increment this+0xC, and return
Otherwise append at the tail: *(this[1] + 4) = v4 links the old tail to the new node, this[1] = v4 makes it the new tail, and this+0xC is incremented
Always return 0; the function is invoked from the session scene init chain

unresolved: Meaning of the node flag byte at node+8 (set to 1) is not determinable from this packet
Why DelegatedFieldGetter returning 2 triggers a prior removal is not documented here
